lines.text: They have beef over a game.

example.text: They have beef over a game.

misuse.text: Don't say 'we have beef' about a small mix-up.
misuse.why: It sounds like a serious feud.

data.l1_hook: Kedua orang itu berhenti berbicara. Kenapa? "beef".

native.tip: “beef” = perseteruan. Contoh: “They have beef over a game.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “beef”?
“beef” = perseteruan.
Contoh: “They have beef over a game.” (Mereka punya "beef" karena sebuah permainan.)
